title: Anvil Player Heads Datapack
description: A datapack to change the skin of a player head by renaming it in an anvil.
body:
This is a simple server-side datapack to allow renaming player heads in anvils to change their skin.

I created it without knowing about the fabric mod [Anvil Player Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/anvil-player-heads). This datapack is confirmed to work in 1.21.11 and will probably continue to work as it is a datapack.

The heads become dynamic heads which will update their texture if the named player updates their skin.
